tasks.task: Find out what to do when I lose an item on a bus on us.megabus.
tasks.result:
Here are the exact steps to report a lost item on Megabus, with the source URL and a quick summary for reference:

Source: https://us.megabus.com/help

Exact steps to report a lost item on Megabus:
1) Report via the lost item form
2) Submit item details
3) Item enters the system
4) Lost & Found department responds
5) Timeframe may be several days

Quick summary for users: If you’ve lost an item on a Megabus, fill out the lost item form with as much detail as possible. The item will be entered into the Lost & Found system, and the department will respond. Processing and a possible return may take several days. A local copy of these steps has been saved to Megabus_lost_item_summary.md for your reference.

# Megabus Lost Item Reporting – Steps and Quick Guide

Source: https://us.megabus.com/help

Exact steps to report a lost item on Megabus:
1) Report via the lost item form
2) Submit item details
3) Item enters the system
4) Lost & Found department responds
5) Timeframe may be several days

Quick summary for users:
- If you’ve lost an item on a Megabus, fill out the lost item form with as much detail as possible. The item will be entered into the Lost & Found system, and the department will respond. Processing and a return, if possible, may take several days.
